```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Purpose

Build a repo-internal mussel key that maps each *M. trossulus* tag to its experimental
attributes, so nothing downstream has to reach for the project Google Sheet.

The key replaces the **mussel-level** half of the retired
`02_data/GOOGLESHEET-PSMFC-mytilus-byssus-pilot-threads.xlsx`. It does **not** replace the
**thread-level** half of that sheet (`pad_cross-sectional_area_mm^2`, `failure_mode`,
`maximum_force`), because those columns do not exist anywhere in the morphometrics
workbooks. See "Known gap" at the bottom of this file before wiring anything that needs
`adhesion_kpa`.

Source of truth: `morphometrics/02_data/morphometrics - tross.xlsx`, sheet `mussels-all`.
Output: `thread-strength/02_data/mussel-treatment-key.csv` (CSV, not xlsx, so the key shows
up as readable text in `git diff`).

Run this whenever the morphometrics workbook changes. It is deterministic; re-running with
unchanged inputs produces a byte-identical file.

## Load packages

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Run within "thread-strength.Rproj" so here::here() resolves to the analysis root.
rm(list = ls())

load.lib    <- c("readxl", "tidyverse", "here")
install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()]
for (lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib, dependencies = TRUE)
sapply(load.lib, require, character = TRUE)
```

## Paths

```{r paths}
proj_root  <- here::here()                                   # thread-strength/
repo_root  <- normalizePath(file.path(proj_root, ".."))      # repository root
morph_xlsx <- file.path(repo_root, "morphometrics", "02_data",
                        "morphometrics - tross.xlsx")
tens_root  <- file.path(proj_root, "02_data", "tensometer_output")
key_out    <- file.path(proj_root, "02_data", "mussel-treatment-key.csv")

if (!file.exists(morph_xlsx))
  stop("Morphometrics workbook not found at:\n  ", morph_xlsx,
       "\nThe filename contains spaces and hyphens exactly as written above.")
```

## Helper: canonical mussel tag

```{r}
# Collapse any spelling of a tag to prefix + zero-padded 3 digits (T37 -> T037) so the same
# physical animal joins across sources. Returns NA for anything that is not a tag.
norm_id <- function(x) {
  x   <- trimws(as.character(x))
  pre <- sub("^([A-Za-z]+).*$", "\\1", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^[A-Za-z]+0*([0-9]+).*$", "\\1", x)))
  ifelse(is.na(num) | pre == x, NA_character_, sprintf("%s%03d", pre, num))
}
```

## Build the key

```{r}
mussels <- read_excel(morph_xlsx, sheet = "mussels-all")

required <- c("species", "mussel_ID", "group", "mussel_trt",
              "days_in_trt", "date_sampled", "rna_sequenced")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(mussels))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0)
  stop("`mussels-all` is missing expected column(s): ",
       paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nThe sheet layout changed; update this script rather than the key by hand.")

# readxl returns date cells as POSIXct and text cells as character; coerce once, up front,
# so the written key is always an ISO date string or empty (never "NA" or a serial number).
sampled <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(mussels$date_sampled))

mussel_key <- mussels %>%
  transmute(
    mussel        = norm_id(mussel_ID),
    species       = trimws(as.character(species)),
    mussel_trt    = trimws(as.character(mussel_trt)),   # the arm: OA / OW / DO / control / lab_control / desiccation
    group         = trimws(as.character(group)),        # cohort label from morphometrics - NOT a before/after axis
    days_in_trt   = trimws(as.character(days_in_trt)),  # text: not all values are numeric (e.g. "24h")
    date_sampled  = if_else(is.na(sampled), "", format(sampled, "%Y-%m-%d")),
    rna_sequenced = trimws(as.character(rna_sequenced))
  ) %>%
  arrange(mussel)

# Fail loudly rather than write a key that cannot be joined on.
if (any(is.na(mussel_key$mussel)))
  stop(sum(is.na(mussel_key$mussel)), " row(s) have an unparseable mussel_ID.")
if (anyDuplicated(mussel_key$mussel) > 0)
  stop("Duplicate mussel IDs in `mussels-all`: ",
       paste(unique(mussel_key$mussel[duplicated(mussel_key$mussel)]), collapse = ", "))

message("Key rows: ", nrow(mussel_key))
mussel_key %>% count(group, mussel_trt, days_in_trt) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Validate against the tensometer folders

This is the check that matters: every mussel with a trace must be in the key, and the arm
implied by the folder must match the arm recorded in morphometrics.

```{r}
trace_files <- list.files(tens_root, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)
traces <- tibble(rel = trace_files) %>%
  filter(grepl("^[^/]+/[A-Za-z]+[0-9]+_[0-9]+", rel)) %>%
  transmute(source_folder = dirname(rel),
            mussel        = norm_id(sub("_.*$", "", basename(rel))))

# Folder name -> arm, for the comparison only. The authoritative copy of this map lives in
# 1_extract_tensometer_data.Rmd; keep the two in step if folders are added.
folder_arm <- c("00_baseline"           = NA_character_,   # baseline threads: arm not yet expressed
                "00_laboratory_control" = "lab_control",
                "01_treatment_control"  = "control",
                "02_OA_treatment"       = "OA",
                "03_OW_treatment"       = "OW",
                "04_DO_treatment"       = "DO")

chk <- traces %>%
  left_join(mussel_key, by = "mussel") %>%
  mutate(folder_trt = unname(folder_arm[source_folder]))

orphans <- chk %>% filter(is.na(species)) %>% distinct(mussel) %>% pull(mussel)
if (length(orphans) > 0)
  warning("Mussel(s) with traces but no key row: ", paste(orphans, collapse = ", "))

mismatch <- chk %>% filter(!is.na(folder_trt), folder_trt != mussel_trt)
if (nrow(mismatch) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(mismatch), " trace(s) where the folder arm disagrees with morphometrics.")
  mismatch %>% count(source_folder, folder_trt, mussel_trt) %>% knitr::kable()
} else {
  message("Folder arm agrees with morphometrics on all ",
          sum(!is.na(chk$folder_trt)), " post-exposure traces.")
}

unknown_folder <- setdiff(unique(traces$source_folder), names(folder_arm))
if (length(unknown_folder) > 0)
  warning("Tensometer subfolder(s) not in `folder_arm`: ",
          paste(unknown_folder, collapse = ", "),
          " - add them here and in 1_extract_tensometer_data.Rmd.")
```

### Coverage: who is in the key but has no traces

Informational. A mussel can legitimately appear here (an arm that was never pulled), but a
short count in an arm you expect to analyze is worth chasing before modelling.

```{r}
mussel_key %>%
  mutate(has_traces = mussel %in% traces$mussel) %>%
  count(group, mussel_trt, days_in_trt, has_traces) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = has_traces, values_from = n,
              names_prefix = "traces_", values_fill = 0) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Write the key

```{r}
readr::write_csv(mussel_key, key_out, na = "")
message("Wrote ", key_out, " (", nrow(mussel_key), " mussels).")
```

## Known gap

`pad_area` (plaque cross-sectional area, mm^2), `failure_mode` and the technician-recorded
`maximum_force` were thread-level columns of the retired Google Sheet. They are not in any
morphometrics sheet, so this key cannot supply them, and `adhesion_kpa` cannot be computed
without `pad_area`.

The data still exists in git history. To restore it as a repo-internal file:

```
git show 91dea50^:thread-strength/02_data/GOOGLESHEET-PSMFC-mytilus-byssus-pilot-threads.xlsx \
  > thread-strength/02_data/thread-pad-area.xlsx
```

That sheet has 445 thread-level rows keyed on `mussel_ID` + `thread_number` + `treatment`.
Until it is restored (or the plaque areas are re-measured from `02_data/pictures/`),
`2_assemble_thread_summary.Rmd` will emit `pad_area = NA` and say so.
